title: Skew cyclic codes through Drinfeld modules
summary: We construct skew cyclic codes in the rank metric from the torsion of the supersingular Drinfeld module $φ_T=t+τ^n$ over $\mathbb{F}_{q^r}$, where $t$ is a root of a monic irreducible $\mathfrak{p}_0\in\mathbb{F}_q[T]$ of degree $r$ coprime to $n$. For every prime $\mathfrak{p}\neq\mathfrak{p}_0$ of degree $d$ and every divisor $m$ of $n$, the torsion $φ[\mathfrak{p}]$ is a free module over the subring $R_0=κ[π^m]$ generated by a power of the Frobenius $π=τ^r$, $κ=\mathbb{F}_q[T]/\mathfrak{p}$, and the codes are the left ideals of the centralizer $R\cong\mathrm{Mat}_m(R_0)$ of $R_0$.
